'''Alida Aldragoran''' is the wife of [[Weilin Aldragoran|Weilin]], a jewel merchant in [[Kayacun]].

==Activities==
When [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] leaves [[The Queen's Lance]] soon after arriving, Weilin becomes disappointed. He knows that Alida would like to meet the wife of the [[Lan Mandragoran|uncrowned King]] of [[Malkier]].{{ref/book|11|20}}
